name: anamnesis_weaponization_ai
label: Anamnesis Reclaimer
poeticVision: Feel the chilling dread as a hunter mimics a combat move Lyra just forgot, or interacts with the environment in a way she can no longer comprehend. Every memory lost doesn't just weaken Lyra; it directly empowers the Silence, turning Lyra's own past into a brutal weapon against her, making each struggle a deeply personal act of self-betrayal.
usage: Attach this script to a CharacterBody3D node representing a Silence hunter. Configure the 'lyra_path' export variable to the NodePath of Lyra (or a dedicated MemoryManager node) that emits a 'memory_lost(memory_type: String)' signal. Set the 'animation_player_path' to the NodePath of an AnimationPlayer child node on the hunter. When Lyra loses a memory (e.g., by emitting 'memory_lost("CombatManeuver")'), the hunter will dynamically gain new abilities or modify its behavior, transitioning into an 'enhanced_hunt' state. Ensure the AnimationPlayer has animations defined for 'idle_animation', 'patrol_animation', 'hunt_animation', 'enhanced_hunt_animation', and 'dash_attack_animation' for visual feedback.

parameters.name: lyra_path
parameters.description: Path to the Lyra or MemoryManager node emitting the 'memory_lost' signal.

parameters.name: animation_player_path
parameters.description: Path to the AnimationPlayer node on the hunter for visual feedback.

dependencies: Node (e.g., Lyra or a MemoryManager) emitting a 'memory_lost(memory_type: String)' signal
verdict: The echoes of a forgotten self become the sharpened claws of the hunter, turning every lost memory into a haunting weapon wielded against Lyra's very being.
impact: This mechanic transforms every memory loss from a simple debuff into a profound act of self-betrayal, making the Silence's hunters terrifying reflections of Lyra's fading self, forcing players to confront their own weakening identity directly in combat. It elevates the core theme of self-loss into a tangible, escalating threat, ensuring that the internal struggle is always mirrored by external danger.
